title: Blueprint Manifest
description: Schema for docs/blueprint/manifest.json — the control surface every blueprint skill reads. Blocks with a fixed key set are closed (additionalProperties: false) so a typo like `autonomy_levle` or `adr_dris` is an error instead of a silent default; blocks whose keys are user/registry data stay open.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema file

format_version.description: Blueprint format version (see blueprint-migration/migrations/ for the ladder)

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last manifest write

created_by.description: Tool -> version map for whatever wrote this manifest (open: new tools may appear)

project.description: Project identity. Fixed key set — closed.

name.description: Project name (from package.json / pyproject.toml / directory name)

type.description: Free-form project classification (e.g. team, solo) — read by blueprint-status

structure.description: Which blueprint artifacts this repo carries, plus the generated-rules output path. Fixed key set — closed (a misspelled `generated_rules_path` would otherwise silently write to the default, issues #1043/#1675).

generated_rules_path.description: Directory generated rules are written to (default .claude/rules/)

featureTracker.description: Feature-tracker wiring. Fixed key set — closed.

source_document.description: Primary requirements document the tracker syncs from

sync_targets.description: Files kept in sync with the tracker (e.g. TODO.md)

generated.description: Provenance for blueprint-generated artifacts, keyed by filename. The three buckets are fixed; the filenames inside them are not.

generatedBucket.description: Filename -> provenance record. Open: keys are user filenames.

generatedRecord.description: Generation provenance for one artifact. Open — migrations may add provenance fields.

customOverrides.description: User-maintained artifacts blueprint must not regenerate. Deliberately OPEN — the bucket set varies by repo and format version.

automation.description: Autonomy configuration (ADR-0020), read by blueprint-plugin/scripts/get-automation-config.sh. Fixed key set — closed: `autonomy_levle` reads as level 0 with no warning otherwise.

autonomy_level.description: 0 fully interactive, 1 ambient bookkeeping, 2 auto-run, 3 out-of-band work orders

interaction_mode.description: Prompting verbosity; absent means level>=2 defaults to quiet, else normal

work_orders.description: Level-3 work-order gates (blueprint-wo-guard.sh). Fixed key set — closed.

context.description: Free-form human rationale for the chosen level

validation.description: Shared validation config (issues #2128/#2129) read by blueprint-plugin/scripts/get-validation-config.sh. Fixed key set — closed: `adr_dris` reads as unconfigured otherwise.

status_vocabulary.description: Document-frontmatter statuses meaning done vs unfinished. NOT the feature-record status enum (that is feature-tracker.schema.json's, and is not configurable).

exclude_basenames.description: Basenames skipped when sweeping requirement docs (default README.md)

adr_dirs.description: ADR directories in precedence order (default docs/adrs then docs/adr)

taskRegistry.description: Maintenance-task registry. Deliberately OPEN at the task-name level — skills are added and renamed independently of this schema.

taskRegistryEntry.description: One maintenance task. Open (a task may carry extra bookkeeping) but typed where a consumer reads it.

idRegistry.description: Document ID <-> path <-> GitHub issue traceability. Fixed key set — closed; the maps inside it are open.

documents.description: Document ID -> record. Open: keys are PRD-NNN / ADR-NNNN / PRP-NNN / WO-NNN ids.

github_issues.description: Reverse index: issue number (as a string key) -> document ids.

idRegistryDocument.description: One registered document. Open — link kinds are additive.

workspaces.description: Monorepo portfolio wiring (format_version >= 3.3.0). Fixed key set — closed.

root_relative_path.description: Child manifests only: relative path from here to the root blueprint

children.description: Root manifests only: cached child-workspace registry (blueprint-workspace-scan)

workspaceChild.description: One discovered child workspace. Open — cached-stat fields are additive.

upgradeHistoryEntry.description: One recorded migration. Open — a migration document may record extra detail.
